title: FLOOR CRATES ARE NEVER LOST OR DOUBLED
why: Found by the code comb of 2026-10-06, all in the Undercroft drop of v18.28: a crate dropped at the stash landed inside the stash reach, often inside its plinth, so E opened the stash and nobody could ever take it, and the item was gone; both windows could take one crate at once; a crate outlived the party and could then be taken by both; a reload or crash deleted a crate whose item had already left the stash. Now the crate lands outside any station reach and wins over a station when you stand nearer it, the dropper cannot take his own crate while linked, and every crate is written in the dropper profile: it comes home when the party ends or at the next load.
now: Items dropped on the Undercroft floor can always be picked up, are never doubled, and come back to you if nobody takes them.
